DEWALT DCR021 is a robust and compact cordless site radio, providing clear DAB+ and FM audio for professional use. Its integral roll cage ensures high impact resistance and durability, making it suitable for demanding construction sites and workshops. The jobsite radio operates on DEWALT XR 10.8V, 14.4V, or 18V Li-ion slide pack batteries, offering flexibility for existing tool users. Dual speakers deliver quality sound, and an Aux input allows connection of external devices. A clear LED display shows power, duration, and clock information, and the water-resistant design supports indoor and outdoor applications.
